$comment: Evidence map for Phase 31. Executable tests cover scale and reliability contracts; live production telemetry and operational execution remain declared.

areas.area: Workloads, pools and service boundaries preserve isolation
areas.requirement: Workloads are typed, assigned only to accepting pools, expensive work is isolated from critical interactive work, and state/service ownership is explicit.

evidence.contains: Scale is proven, not assumed
isolates expensive workloads from critical interactive workloads
requires all six state-management dimensions
requires service ownership at the boundary

areas.area: Capacity quotas, rate limits, queues and event streams are bounded
areas.requirement: Quota hierarchy, protected capacity, adaptive limits, backpressure, queue completeness, ordering and replay retention are governed.

evidence.contains: builds a hierarchy with one quota per scope
enforces quotas while preserving protected capacity
engages explicit backpressure instead of uncontrolled overload
requires a complete queue architecture
requires governed retention for controlled replay

areas.area: Consistency, idempotency, SLOs and latency budgets match workload truth
areas.requirement: Authoritative operations use appropriate consistency, duplicate delivery requires idempotency, service tiers and error/latency budgets are measurable.

evidence.contains: keeps authoritative operations strongly consistent
requires idempotency when duplicate delivery is possible
computes and exhausts error budgets
manages tail latency across all buckets

areas.area: Recovery objectives, failure domains, cells and resilience are explicit
areas.requirement: RPO/RTO, replication, failure isolation, cell boundaries, regional architecture and resilience controls are complete before readiness claims.

evidence.contains: checks recovery objectives
requires complete replication contracts
isolates failure domains from the platform
requires two regions for active-active
requires circuit breakers, bulkheads, and timeouts

areas.area: Capacity forecasts, autoscaling and chaos tests require evidence
areas.requirement: Peak demand/headroom, bounded autoscaling, scale-to-zero constraints, production-like load certification and controlled chaos experiments are explicit.

evidence.contains: projects peak demand from growth, seasonality, and AI demand
binds autoscaling with min/max and budget limits
permits scale-to-zero only for noncritical workloads
certifies capacity only with evidence
requires chaos experiments to be controlled

areas.area: Operations, incidents, readiness, cost and performance remain governed
areas.requirement: Incident progression, alert severity, runbook steps, operational readiness, abnormal cost growth, cost circuits and performance contracts are explicit.

evidence.contains: advances incidents one stage at a time with command
requires runbook steps and flags automatable runbooks
passes operational readiness gates only when complete
detects abnormal cost growth and binds cost circuit breakers
requires a documented performance contract

areas.area: Provisioning, rollout, rollback, policy and configuration drift are controlled
areas.requirement: Provisioning/deprovisioning, progressive delivery, kill switches, rollback compatibility, reversible policies and configuration drift detection are explicit.

evidence.contains: advances provisioning one stage at a time
advances progressive delivery with a small canary
requires controlled kill switches
requires rollback strategies and forward-compatible database changes
detects configuration drift

areas.area: Service ownership, readiness, bottlenecks, mass events and recovery order are explicit
areas.requirement: Services have owners and readiness evidence, bottlenecks are prioritized, mass events are controlled, event storms are protected, and recovery respects dependencies.

evidence.contains: registers owned services in the catalog
labels readiness levels with evidence
registers and prioritizes bottlenecks
controls mass events within thresholds
recovers dependencies before dependents

areas.area: Autonomous scale actions and engineering contracts remain bounded
areas.requirement: Autonomous scale actions require bounded/observable/rollback-capable contracts, and services cannot access data they do not own.

evidence.contains: binds autonomous control loops with safety properties
never accesses data a service does not own

areas.area: Live enterprise telemetry and operational execution are wired
areas.requirement: Capacity, SLO, error-budget, queue, cost and recovery records are collected from a live runtime and operational runbooks can execute with evidence.

evidence.contains: capacity models
